mdm.instructions: German colleague/MDM guide; targeted quarantine command
mdm.sourceRule: The same signed full-edition bundle must be installed and approved locally, packaged for manual download and published to the colleague updater together.

public.sourceRule: The app package must come from a clean, published public Git commit. Its GitHub release and Beelink manual-download pointer belong to that same release.

releaseRules: Builds and local installations do not advance any public link.
Upload immutable versioned files and verify SHA-256 before moving latest.
The MDM landing page follows the updater latest.json; it has no independent latest pointer.
Public latest.json is the signed Public release manifest, never the colleagues updater configuration.
Keep older versioned files available; never replace different bytes under an existing version.
Record a release as complete only after verifying every required public link and its source/profile/version.
